message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration, framed in red with a yellow background, features a large caricature as its central focus. At the top, the masthead "TEMPO" is printed in large, black serif letters. Above it, a red banner contains the white text "Wawancara Khusus dengan Nurcholish Madjid." Below the masthead is the date "EDISI 28 April-4 Mei 2003." To the right, black block letters read "PRESIDEN BARU VERSI GOLKAR."

The central figure is a man wearing a yellow suit jacket, a white shirt, and a red tie. This figure's body is small compared to its oversized head, which features gray hair and rectangular glasses. A massive, detached pale hand descends from above, its fingers gripping and lifting the man's head away from his neck. The neck appears as a dark, coiled spring where the head was once attached. Below the figure, a second, smaller detached head with black hair and a long nose lies on the ground. A barcode and price "Rp 14.700" are visible at the bottom.
